name: Impact shake

provenance.note: editor grammar (R4: slight shake on stamps)

summary: A stamp, a slam, a bass drop, a bold claim landing; pair with an impact sound.

data.about: A short, decaying jolt of position and roll, as if something heavy just landed; deterministic noise, so every render matches.
data.avoid: Text that must be read during the shake; more than one per beat; calm brands.
